name: Critical Care Time-series Imputation Benchmark
description: Compares imputation strategies for missing time-series data in critical care using realistic, clinically inspired scenarios and datasets.
evaluation_method: RMSE/MAE/NRMSE for imputation quality and downstream predictive performance metrics (e.g., AUROC) for clinical tasks
reputation: Moderately used in clinical ML research for comparing imputation methods; recognized but not a single community standard.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark; sensitive to missingness mechanisms and dataset shifts; limited by clinical data access/privacy; downstream-task evaluation is recommended alongside imputation metrics.
